summary: The bounded sequence, conservative effect recovery, scoped approval prerequisite and feature-only delivery policy are coherent. Correct the missing Project Chat host authority and bind externally defined V1 requirements into the canonical contract before approval. Read-only review, not execution authorization.

findings.summary: Permitted paths omit apps/web/app/page.tsx, which owns selectedMode, sessionId, useHarnessChat and chat props. The new Stop and local panel need this integration host; current task, contract and repair boundaries exclude it.
findings.requirement: STOP-1, UI-1 and UI-3: session-and-run-scoped Stop and status for the selected Project conversation.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add apps/web/app/page.tsx to relevant task, contract and repair allowed paths. Include it and components/chat/chat.tsx in evidence; leave separate IDE surface out of scope.

findings.summary: Precise V1 retention/read-model/persistence requirements reside in mutable plan.md. The canonical contract digest does not include linked files, so material prose edits can leave approval unchanged.
findings.requirement: V1 foundation and material-change approval invalidation.
findings.proposedCorrection: Inline normative requirements or bind immutable specification digests in the contract and validate before execution. Regenerate digest/manifest and obtain fresh critique.
